content.short: Solidity Auditor provides Web3 legal, token-structuring, compliance, and audit-adjacent support for crypto teams.
content.description: Solidity Auditor is presented as a global Web3 law and advisory firm for crypto, blockchain, and fintech teams. Its public site highlights token structuring, legal opinions, MiCA readiness, intellectual-property work, licensing, GDPR, and AI compliance. In this registry it is useful as a security and compliance support provider: projects can use it around launch preparation, legal risk, and review workflows that sit next to technical smart-contract audits.
content.meta: Solidity Auditor supports crypto teams with Web3 legal, token, compliance, and audit-adjacent work. Discover it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
